name: Bee Partners
identity_check: Bee Partners (beepartners.vc), San Francisco-based pre-seed venture firm led by managing partner Michael Berolzheimer, investing in 'human-machine convergence' (AI, ML, robotics, frontier tech). Confirmed via TechCrunch's Fund IV article and the UC Berkeley BEGIN directory, which links to beepartners.vc.
